verses.text: 13. She also said, ’It is good not to get angry, but if this should happen, the Apostle does not allow you a whole day for this passion, for he says: ”Let not the sun go down” (Eph. 4.25). Will you wait till all your time is ended? Why hate the man who has grieved? It is not he who has done the wrong, but the devil. Hate sickness but not the sick person.’
